post.description: Owner-only replenishment policy upsert. Organization, outlet and the default usable-stock location are derived from the authenticated server runtime; an optional explicit location remains supported for trusted integrations and must match the canonical location. The requested active item must exist even when it has no balance yet. The policy state is HMAC-bound and committed through the same PostgreSQL compare-and-swap aggregate as recommendations. Same-origin, operator cookie and CSRF are required.

200.description: Durably persisted policy or idempotent replay

404.description: Canonical active inventory item does not exist in the server-owned scope.

500.description: Persisted planning state failed integrity validation; internal details are redacted.

503.description: Canonical inventory provider or durable replenishment store unavailable.

post.description: Owner-only recommendation command. Stock, reservation, incoming, outgoing and expiry buckets come from the authoritative inventory provider for the server-owned organization/outlet/item/location scope; caller-authored inventory buckets are rejected. The body carries only the operation key, horizon and non-authoritative planning parameters. The durable fact binds provider revision and observed timestamp, uses HMAC-bound state plus provider CAS, and never writes physical inventory balances. Same-origin, operator cookie and CSRF are required.

201.description: Durably persisted recommendation or idempotent replay

404.description: No durable replenishment policy exists for the server-scoped item and location.

500.description: Authoritative provider or persisted planning state failed integrity validation; internal details are redacted.

post.description: Owner or manager reads the open-shift ledger and proposed cash close; no approval or cash mutation is created. Organization/outlet and principal always come from the server session. Requires same-origin and the operator cookie plus CSRF for POST. Production Owner-only cannot complete approval-dependent inventory/variance workflows because no distinct checker is available; a second Owner login or HR SSO delegation does not create another POS principal. Self-approval remains 409 maker_checker_distinct_principals_required. No provider/payment/hardware capability is enabled by this contract.

post.description: Owner or manager approves an existing reliability request as a distinct checker. This shared approval handler may return either stored command type; the URL cannot change the request action. New approvals expire after 15 minutes; approval replay returns its existing authorization and cannot renew it. Organization/outlet and principal always come from the server session. Requires same-origin and the operator cookie plus CSRF for POST. Production Owner-only cannot complete approval-dependent inventory/variance workflows because no distinct checker is available; a second Owner login or HR SSO delegation does not create another POS principal. post.description: Read-only own request list. Active staff role, employee binding and explicit source request.own.write required even for dual-role HR. Fixed staff.requests.list dispatch; generic requests operations never used. Body-only opaque cursor, no query parameters; no-store/no-referrer. Output is strict minimal provider projection, maximum requested limit. No totals or snapshot across pages. Invalid cursor requires a fresh first-page read.

Historical state strings rendered as text, not current enum assumptions.

post.description: Owner closes an ESB DUAL_WRITE_V1 shift from persisted cash movements. Zero variance can close without a checker; nonzero variance requires the exact approved command. Other modes retain the legacy blind-close behavior and are outside this ESB response contract. Organization/outlet and principal always come from the server session. Requires same-origin and the operator cookie plus CSRF for POST. Production Owner-only cannot complete approval-dependent inventory/variance workflows because no distinct checker is available; a second Owner login or HR SSO delegation does not create another POS principal. Self-approval remains 409 maker_checker_distinct_principals_required. No provider/payment/hardware capability is enabled by this contract.

post.description: Owner/Admin archives a product without deleting publication history.

Owner-only versioned actions. catalog.product.update accepts productId, name, integer priceRupiah, optional categoryId, station (bar/food), status (active/archived), sortRank (0..999), reason and expectedVersion. catalog.ordering.update accepts boolean paused/enforceHours, opensAt/lastOrderAt/closesAt as same-day HH:mm WIB, reason and expectedVersion. Archive retains historical snapshots. Pause/hours gate new quotes/checkouts only; existing payment settlement remains available.

ShiftCloseInput.description: ESB DUAL_WRITE_V1 close. cashToLeaveRupiah must not exceed actualCashRupiah. An omitted note defaults to Owner verified cash close. Variance requires an unexpired, unconsumed authorization bound to this actor, operationKey, reason, amounts and current ledger fingerprint. Exact zero-variance close may omit authorizationId. Reuse the exact body/key for replay; use a new key for a new close revision.
